**Zendaya Maree Stoermer Coleman**[[a]] (born September 1, 1996) is an American actress and singer.[[b]] Known for her work in television, [blockbuster films] "Blockbuster (entertainment)"), and advertising, [her accolades] include two [Primetime Emmy Awards] and a [Golden Globe Award]. She has been featured on Forbes' 30 under 30 list and _[Time] "Time (magazine)")_ magazine named her one of the [100 most influential people in the world] in 2022. Zendaya's films as a [leading actress] have grossed over $9.8 billion worldwide.

Born in [Oakland, California], Zendaya began her career as a child model and dancer before gaining prominence for her roles on the [Disney Channel] sitcoms _[Shake It Up] "Shake It Up (American TV series)")_ (2010–2013) and _[K.C. Undercover]_ (2015–2018), the latter of which she also produced. For her performance as the drug-addicted teenager [Rue Bennett] in the [HBO] drama series _[Euphoria] "Euphoria (American TV series)")_ (2019–2026), Zendaya was nominated for three [Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Lead Actress in a Drama Series] and won two, becoming the youngest performer to win the award.

Zendaya made her feature film debut as [Michelle Jones-Watson] "MJ (Marvel Cinematic Universe)") in the [Marvel Cinematic Universe] film _[Spider-Man: Homecoming]_ (2017). She reprised the role in the film's sequels _[Far From Home]_ (2019), _[No Way Home]_ (2021), and _[Brand New Day]_ (2026). She also starred in the musical film _[The Greatest Showman]_ (2017), [Denis Villeneuve]'s [_Dune_ trilogy]#Films "Dune (franchise)") (2021–2026), and _[The Odyssey] "The Odyssey (2026 film)")_ (2026), and has earned praise for her performances in the romance films _[Malcolm & Marie]_ (2021), _[Challengers] "Challengers (film)")_ (2024) and _[The Drama] "The Drama (film)")_ (2026).

In 2013, Zendaya released the album [_Zendaya_] "Zendaya (album)") with [Hollywood Records]. Its lead single, "[Replay] "Replay (Zendaya song)")", peaked in the top 40 of the US [_Billboard_ Hot 100] and earned multi-platinum certifications. "[Rewrite the Stars]", her duet with [Zac Efron] from the 2017 [soundtrack for _The Greatest Showman_] "The Greatest Showman (soundtrack)"), charted in the top 20 and achieved multi-platinum status in various countries. Zendaya wrote the 2013 book _Between U and Me: How to Rock Your Tween Years with Style and Confidence_, and in 2021 she became the youngest person to win the CFDA Fashion Icon award at the [CFDA Fashion Awards].

## Early life

Zendaya was born in [Oakland, California].[[8]][[9]] Her name derives from the [Shona] name _[Tendai]_ (meaning 'to give thanks').[[10]] Both of her parents were working as teachers at the time of her birth.[[11]] Her father, Kazembe Ajamu Coleman, is a black American with Nigerian ancestry.[[12]] Her mother, Claire Stoermer, has German and Scottish ancestry.[[13]] Zendaya has six older half-siblings from her father's previous relationships: Latonja, Austin, Julien, Kaylee, Katianna and AnnaBella.[[14]] Zendaya's parents divorced in 2016.[[11]]

Zendaya attended [Fruitvale Elementary School] in [Oakland], where her mother taught.[[15]] She was described as energetic and outgoing at home but reserved and shy at school. At the end of her first school year, her parents had her repeat kindergarten to help build her confidence.[[9]] Because of her father's passion for basketball, Zendaya's parents enrolled her in a local basketball team. After losing interest in the sport, she switched to soccer and track, but lost interest in those sports, too.[[16]] At age six, Zendaya and two of her friends—the only three Black children at the school—convinced the principal to let them perform a play for [Black History Month].[[17]]
